macro.title: Credit Market Shifts
macro.body: The recent trends in the credit market could lead to increased volatility in the financial sector, affecting the portfolio's holdings in Canadian banks such as CM.TO and RY.TO. A shift in credit market conditions may impact the creditworthiness of borrowers and, in turn, affect the portfolio's exposure to the financial sector.
macro.bull: A stable credit market could lead to increased investor confidence, positively impacting the portfolio's financial sector holdings.
macro.base: The credit market is expected to remain relatively stable, with minimal impact on the portfolio's financial sector holdings.
macro.bear: A downturn in the credit market could lead to decreased investor confidence, negatively impacting the portfolio's financial sector holdings.

macro.title: Regulatory Environment
macro.body: The current regulatory environment may lead to increased scrutiny of companies' practices, potentially affecting the portfolio's holdings in various sectors. A change in regulations could impact the portfolio's exposure to certain industries.

macro.base: The regulatory environment is expected to remain relatively stable, with minimal impact on the portfolio's holdings.

risks.title: Leverage Amplification Risk
risks.context: 49% of portfolio (~ $135K CAD) in leveraged ETFs
risks.body: The portfolio's significant exposure to leveraged ETFs, such as FNGU and SPXL, amplifies both gains and losses. A market downturn could result in substantial losses due to the 3x leverage.

risks.title: FX Exposure Risk
risks.context: 68% USD exposure (~ $180K CAD) with a FX book of 1.3925
risks.body: The portfolio's significant USD exposure, combined with the current FX rate, may result in losses if the CAD strengthens against the USD.

risks.title: Sector Overlap Risk
risks.context: Multiple holdings in the tech sector (NVDA, MSFT, AAPL, etc.)
risks.body: The portfolio's concentration in the tech sector may result in increased volatility if the sector experiences a downturn.
